name: Mantra Collector
desc:
Mantra Collectors are NPCs that purchase Mantra Modifiers for cheap prices. They are mostly Canor (with the exception of Leaf, being the only Lightborn) that speak in broken English, and refer to Notes as sand dollars.

They can be typically found on the Surface in:

-   [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils), Cumberland will be on a rug in front of the bank.
-   [Etris](location:etris), Schnitzel will be on a rug in the Etris Docks.
-   [Summer Isle](location:summer_isle), Hotdog will be inside the castle.
-   [Greathive Aratel](location:greathive_aratel), Schnitzel will be locate.
-   [Miner's Landing](location:miners_landing), Schnitzel will be on a rug near the mantra shop and [Maedhran](entity:maedhran)
-   [The Floating Keep](location:the_floating_keep), Leaf
additional_info:
-   In the July 7th, 2025 update, Croissant was removed from the [Voidheart](location:voidheart).
-   Most of them are named after German meat dishes.
    -   Schnitzel is a thin slice of meat, which is usually breaded then fried.
    -   Hotdog refers to a sausage in a bun.
        -   Hotdogs are associated with the condiments mustard and ketchup, which are bright yellow and deep red respectively. Hotdog has bright yellow skin and deep red hair.
    -   Cumberland may refer to a type of sausage.
        -   Cumberland is also the name of a region in England of Anglo-Saxon origin, who came from areas in Germany.
    -   Croissant, prior to their removal, is a rare exception. Croissants are a viennoiserie Austrian pastry, layered with butter and rolled multiple times in succession. Germany and Austria are close both historically and geographically, so it still follows the theme to an extent. Furthermore, Croissant the Canor is noted to be a pariah.
-   Sand dollars are a species of sea urchins. It's likely that the term is used here as a pun referring to the real-world currency (minus the sand).
